data.notes: July 2026 in Montréal is anchored by the Jazz Fest closing weekend, Nuits d’Afrique, Piknic/OfF Piknic electronic programming, Osheaga’s opening day, and several major Bell Centre arena concerts.

events.title: Festival International de Jazz de Montréal
events.venueName: Quartier des spectacles / Place des Arts
events.summary: The 46th edition of Montréal’s flagship jazz festival runs into early July with hundreds of indoor and outdoor concerts. Confirmed 2026 programming includes major Place des Arts concerts and free outdoor stages.

events.title: OSHEAGA Music and Arts Festival
events.summary: OSHEAGA opens on July 31 and runs through August 2 at Parc Jean-Drapeau. The confirmed 2026 headliners are Twenty One Pilots on Friday, Tate McRae on Saturday and Lorde on Sunday.

events.title: Festival International Nuits d’Afrique
events.venueName: Quartier des spectacles and multiple Montréal venues
events.summary: The 40th edition of Nuits d’Afrique is confirmed for July 7–19, 2026. The festival focuses on music from Africa, the Caribbean and Latin America across indoor venues and outdoor stages.

events.title: Ariana Grande: The Eternal Sunshine Tour
events.summary: Ariana Grande brings The Eternal Sunshine Tour to the Bell Centre on July 28, with a second Montréal date also listed for July 30. The tour marks her return to the stage after the Sweetener World Tour era.

events.title: J. Cole: The Fall-Off Tour
events.summary: J. Cole’s The Fall-Off Tour stops at the Bell Centre on July 25. The tour supports his 2026 album The Fall Off, according to the evenko event page.

events.title: Lionel Richie and Earth, Wind & Fire: Sing a Song All Night Long
events.summary: Lionel Richie and Earth, Wind & Fire bring the Sing a Song All Night Long tour to the Bell Centre. evenko lists the concert as presented as part of the Festival International de Jazz de Montréal.

events.title: Tame Impala: The Deadbeat Tour
events.summary: Tame Impala brings The Deadbeat Tour to the Bell Centre with Djo as support. The evenko listing confirms a 7:00 pm show on July 22, 2026.

events.title: Festival International Nuits d’Afrique — 40th Edition
events.venueName: Quartier des spectacles and multiple Montréal venues
events.summary: Montréal’s major African, Caribbean, and Latin diaspora music festival returns for its 40th edition, spanning indoor concerts, outdoor stages, and club-sized venue programming.

events.title: OfF Piknic: Anjunadeep with Marsh, Christian Löffler, Eric Luttrell b2b Jody Wisternoff and Nicky Elisabeth
events.venueName: Jardin Le Petit Prince - Parc Jean-Drapeau
events.summary: OfF Piknic hosts an Anjunadeep-branded open-air electronic bill at Parc Jean-Drapeau. The listed lineup features Marsh, Christian Löffler (Live), Eric Luttrell b2b Jody Wisternoff and Nicky Elisabeth.

events.title: OfF Piknic: Zeds Dead and Whethan
events.venueName: Jardin Le Petit Prince - Parc Jean-Drapeau
events.summary: OfF Piknic presents Zeds Dead with Whethan on the Fizz Stage under the Journey of a Lifetime banner. The event is scheduled from 17:00 to 22:00 at Parc Jean-Drapeau.

events.title: OfF Piknic: Adam Port & &ME
events.summary: A sold-out OfF Piknic evening at Parc Jean-Drapeau with two core Keinemusik-affiliated names, marking one of July’s biggest outdoor house moments in Montréal.

events.title: IVE WORLD TOUR <SHOW WHAT I AM> IN MONTREAL
events.summary: K-pop group IVE brings the WORLD TOUR <SHOW WHAT I AM> to Montréal. evenko confirms the Bell Centre date for July 23, 2026.

events.title: Piknic Électronik MTL #11: Daphni / KARABA & Friends
events.summary: One of July’s strongest Piknic bookings, pairing Daphni with a KARABA & Friends stage that highlights Afro-diasporic and club-minded Montréal selectors.

events.title: Piknic Électronik MTL #8: Nia Archives (DJ Set) / KNTC
events.summary: A strong Sunday Piknic pairing of Nia Archives’ UK club energy with a KNTC stage featuring Vincent Lemieux and Dimitry Duchesse.

events.title: Billy Talent & Alexisonfire: 20 Years in the Making
events.summary: Canadian rock heavyweights Billy Talent and Alexisonfire co-headline the Bell Centre with Faze supporting. The show is billed as 20 Years in the Making.

events.title: Piknic Électronik: Daphni, Raef, pleurire, DJ Karaba, KidCrayola and Mansa
events.venueName: Jardin Le Petit Prince - Parc Jean-Drapeau
events.summary: Piknic Électronik’s July 26 program is topped by Daphni on the Fizz Stage. The National Bank Stage features Karaba & Friends with DJ Karaba, KidCrayola and Mansa.

events.title: Dômesicle x HomeBy6 — AceMo (US) • Casa Kobrae b2b Felix Patry
events.summary: HomeBy6 co-presents a SAT dome night with New York underground figure AceMo and a Montréal b2b from Casa Kobrae and Felix Patry, spanning house, techno, breaks and club music.

events.title: Groove N’ Kizomba Festival — 9th Edition
events.summary: A Greater Montréal all-in-one dance weekender centered on kizomba, semba, konpa, urban kiz and diaspora club sounds including afro-house and amapiano.

events.title: Township Rebellion
events.summary: A late-running Stereo booking for Township Rebellion, fitting Montréal’s deep/progressive house and melodic techno after-hours lane.

events.title: Piknic Électronik MTL #9: Zack Fox / Ferias
events.summary: A summer Piknic edition pairing Zack Fox with a Ferias-curated second stage, including Vasimolo b2b Aram, THe LYONZ live, and Andie.
